purpose: The main branch holds only the content that supports the conclusions: conclusion documents, precise claims, proof sources, run receipts and a portable replay. Everything else stays on dev.
authorization: Researcher, 2026-09-30: organize main as the curated conclusion-and-evidence branch, generated from dev rather than edited directly. Researcher, 2026-10-01 follow-up (原话：main分支的其他文档都按照更新过了吗？都推送了吗？没做的赶紧做。): review the remaining reader-facing documents for repository jargon, preserve recent Opus plain-language rewrites and exact mathematical evidence, update what still needs reader-facing explanation, regenerate main, and push dev/main. Researcher, 2026-10-01 follow-up (原话：全部做完): complete the three accepted documentation follow-ups—rewrite the public README's research-process section as a reader route without deleting source records; add English, German, French, and Russian translations of the phase-close report through the existing hash-pinned translation path; and audit the published language versions for fidelity on ring/A7 attribution and evidence-status boundaries, preserving Opus translations unless a concrete error is found—then regenerate and push dev/main. The audit found one concrete source-level attribution overstatement in community paper 02: a line attributed the AI's B-direction mapping and two-gate outcomes to the researcher's overall verdict, while current `rulings.md` explicitly classifies that mapping as AI interpretation rather than a word-for-word user ruling. Correct only that row in the Chinese original and its four translations; leave the rest of the Opus prose and all mathematical claims unchanged. Researcher, 2026-10-15, rulings made with a GLM session (archive on dev: .claude/goals/CG-010-remaining-formalization-alignment/待你裁定-人话版/10-裁定结果-20261015.md): D6-3, release once the rulings are carried out, with the README shown to the researcher first and generated and pushed only after approval; D4-2, the README's 'which premise' becomes the ready-made collection (A), univalence a cause; D7, the circle's line-by-line formalization is the standard one. Researcher, 2026-10-15, to the executing Claude session: "确保了这些之后，你立即开始做，直至全部做完". This release adds the ZFC side that the research converged on (the researcher's 'ZFC Failure' section at the top of main, 2026-10-04): the packages and runs listed in docs/ZFC-1的问题-原话逐句对照与机器证明-20261015.md §6, plus the two truncation-completion packages that CLAIMS section 1 already names (C-357, C-358).
principle: Researcher's public-delivery ruling recorded in MATH-FOURNITY-公开仓库规划-20260919.md: readers get the final results, precise propositions, reproducible machine evidence, clear boundaries and open problems; they need not consume user-AI dialogues, the four core documents, dev-notes, governance or debugging history. Researcher, 2026-10-01, on how main should read: the philosophical significance is the revival of the ghosts of Russell's and Zeno's paradoxes, not only the unreasonableness found in HoTT. All narrative conclusion documents should be told plainly enough for a high-school, even middle-school, reader to follow, while retaining the seriousness of the philosophy of mathematics. Keep formal statements, identifiers, source quotations, diagnostics, paths, and run records exact; explain necessary technical terms nearby rather than renaming or deleting them. Recent plain-language rewrites are preserved unless a concrete misunderstanding requires a narrow correction (原话：我总是秉承一个原则，我的数学哲学是力图让高中生，甚至是初中生都能够听懂的).
